question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

events.title: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
events.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s position as China’s paramount leader remains secure heading into late 2026, with analysts across reporting consistently describing his control over the Communist Party, state institutions, and military as firm ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for 2027. Recent Beidaihe leadership meetings and ongoing anti-corruption purges in the military and civilian ranks are widely viewed as mechanisms for enforcing loyalty and preparing personnel changes that preserve rather than challenge his authority. Xi, now 73, has given no public indication of stepping down, and the removal of presidential term limits in 2018 allows him to pursue a fourth term at the congress without formal barriers. Economic headwinds and foreign policy pressures have not translated into visible elite challenges or succession moves that would alter this trajectory before 2027. Trader consensus reflected in the 95% “No” price aligns with this assessment of institutional continuity and centralized power.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the named individual wins and accepts the 2028 nomination of the Democratic Party for U.S. president. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Democratic Party sources.

Any replacement of the democratic nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

eventMetadata.context_description: The crowded 2028 Democratic field remains fragmented, with no candidate securing broad consensus support nearly two years before the primaries. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez leads trader pricing at 20.8 percent amid strength in early-state surveys like New Hampshire, followed closely by Senators Jon Ossoff and Governor Gavin Newsom, as multiple governors, senators, and former officials weigh bids. Recent DNC narrowing of the 2028 convention to Boston, Denver, or Philadelphia underscores preparations for an open contest after the 2026 midterms. Trader positioning reflects uncertainty over how midterm results, fundraising, early-state polling, and any formal declarations could consolidate support or elevate specific contenders from the progressive and moderate wings.
